interpretation.exact_action_meaning: The exact unamended Senate-engrossed S2393 would permit the VA Secretary to carry out a fiscal2026 major medical-facility project in St. Louis: a new bed tower, clinical-building expansion, consolidated administrative building and warehouse, utility plant and parking garages. The maximum authorized project amount is $1,762,668,000. Section2(b) separately authorizes appropriations of that amount for fiscal2026 OR the year funds are appropriated to the Construction, Major Projects account. Neither clause is an actual appropriation or a completed construction/care delivery claim. The short title says Fiscal Year2025 while the operative project/appropriation clauses say fiscal2026; retain the printed distinction, not a silent title-based correction. Defined clinical infrastructure establishes proposed Health membership, within a mixed medical/admin/site project rather than wholly direct treatment spending. No general veteran benefit, patient admission rule, guaranteed construction schedule or medical outcome follows. The May20 House suspension-and-passage question passed405-5/20Not Voting. A Yea supported passing this exact authorization; a Nay opposed it. Not Voting is resolved nondirectional, not opposition. House passage is not enactment, obligation of funds, completed construction or delivered care.
